title: History and Geography based game inspired by geoguessr
author: dbouslov
selftext:
Been working on this for a few months now, check it out at [eraguessr.ai](http://eraguessr.ai)

  
Happy to answer any questions or take any feedback as well!

  
Most recently added the **Sprint mode** because my attention span is too short sometimes and **The Atlas** which lets you track your discoveries. Currently working on a bunch of new features including country/region specific gamemodes, learning focused gamemode, and a map that lets you explore all the scenes we have across the eras kind of like googlemaps with street view but throughout history! Happy to hear your ideas for other features to add next. 

**Completely free btw!!**

comments.body: Man this is absolutely incredible! Especially the timemap ...having a lot of fun with it. You won't plan to charge for it?
